description: Shared vectors of the cry reasons scoring (cryReasons.ts scoreCrySignals and Lotties.Domain.CryReasons.CryReasonRanker.Rank). Each case gives the extracted signals and the ranking both ports must produce; null members count as absent. Generated from the web port; edit by hand only together with both implementations.
